time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t * 24); frame 0 at t = 0
units: pixels and seconds; image x to the right, y down; no metric scale assumed
view: orthographic-looking top-down view of a uniform light-grey ground plane (bg ~157 grey); two cars drive in opposite directions on parallel horizontal lanes. Very mild perspective near the image edges (apparent car length grows by up to ~4% at x<300 or x>1600).

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of a car-free background band gives 0.00 px shift for all frames)

yellow_car.description: yellow (gold) sedan/coupe, upper lane (y ~358-473), nose pointing LEFT, drives left (-x). Has dark glass roof, side mirrors at y=358 and ~473.
yellow_car.reference_point: centre of mask bounding box (ref_x, ref_y) = proxy for the object origin

size_px.length_note: 270 px for frames 0-31 (car centre x 863..562); 272 for x 550..290; 274-277 for frames 59-71 near the left edge (perspective/side visible). Use 270 as the rest length.
size_px.body_width_without_mirrors_y: 94 (median per-column), up to 100 at wheel arches

black_car.description: black-and-white car (black rear half/roof, white/silver front half and nose), lower lane (y ~482-598), nose pointing RIGHT, drives right (+x). Side mirrors at y~482 and ~598.
black_car.reference_point: centre of mask bounding box (ref_x, ref_y) = proxy for the object origin

size_px.length_note: 268-270 px for car centre x 980..1330 (frames 15-40); grows to 271-277 for x 1340..1610 and 278-281 for frames 65-71 near the right edge (perspective). 270-274 in frames 0-14 when side by side with the yellow car. Use ~269 as rest length.
size_px.body_width_without_mirrors_y: 93 (median per-column), up to 100 at wheel arches

ground.description: uniform light-grey plane filling the whole image; no markings, no lines, no other props. Soft dark blob shadows around each car (darker by <= ~30 grey levels, extending ~50-100 px).

relations.cars_overlap_in_x: frames 0-15 (side by side, yellow ahead of black's nose by ~77 px at start); from frame 16 they are apart in x and separate further

events.event: both cars stationary (frame 1 is pixel-identical to frame 0)
start of motion of both cars (first nonzero displacement between frames 1 and 2)
events.note: already at full per-frame displacement at frame 2: yellow -10 px, black +13..14 px; no ramp-up visible

events.event: cars stop overlapping in x (start side by side and diverge; first frame with yellow bbox_x1 < black bbox_x0)
events.note: they never pass each other: yellow is already left-of/ahead of black's rear at start and drives left, black drives right

events.event: end of clip, both still moving at constant per-frame displacement, both fully in frame

track_observations: From frame 2 to 71 the yellow car's ref_x decreases by exactly 10 px every frame (852.5 -> 162.0, 690.5 px in 69 frames); the black car's ref_x increases by 13.96 px/frame on average (797.5 -> 1761.0; rear edge 663 -> 1621 = 13.88 px/frame, front edge 932 -> 1901 = 14.04 px/frame, difference from edge-perspective growth). No vertical motion (y constant within 1 px). No direction changes, no contact.
